title: The sharp Whitney extension theorem for convex $C^1$ Lipschitz functions
summary: For an arbitrary set $E \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, and functions $f:E \to \mathbb{R}$, $G: E\to \mathbb{R}^n$ with $G$ bounded, we construct $C^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$ convex extensions $(F, \nabla F)$ of $(f,G)$ with the sharp Lipschitz constant $$ \mathrm{Lip}(F) = \sup_{x\in E} |G(x)|, $$ provided that $(f,G)$ satisfies the pertinent necessary and sufficient conditions for $C^1$ convex, and Lipschitz extendability. Also, these extensions can be constructed with prescribed global behavior in terms of directions of coercivity.
